name: roman chair sit up
description: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.
